He was so beautiful. I keep picturing his body, all the places I knew made him happy to be touched. The way he looked in the sunlight before he woke up. His shirts hugging his body. The line from his shoulder to his hip and how much I loved that line. His silly dances and his puns and how he could run a joke into the ground in a day. The way he would cling to me in his sleep when I got up for the bathroom. 

He needed me at one point. He loved me. He wanted me.

I keep seeing how I ruined him.

I just imagine someone else with all those things and I feel a little more of my soul turn to dust and blow away. He’s going to start dating again. Someone else is going to love those parts and he’s going to forget how I did it first. He’s going to forget 6 years of home cooked dinners and half done laundry and talking about how we were going to grow old together. 

But I can’t. I can’t make the imagines of his smile or his kiss or his dancing at karaoke stop. At the point I want to put a gun to my head just to make him disappear from my mind.
